enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Pulls blanket. Remains asleep.

Opens eyes. Sits up in bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Washes hands with soap. Turns off tap. Dries hands with towel. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and cereal box. Closes refrigerator. Opens cabinet. Takes out bowl and spoon. Closes cabinet. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Puts milk back in refrigerator. Sits at table. Eats cereal with spoon. Drinks remaining milk from bowl. Stands up. Picks up bowl and spoon. Walks to sink. Rinses bowl and spoon. Opens dishwasher. Places bowl and spoon in dishwasher. Closes dishwasher. Wipes table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt and pants. Closes wardrobe. Opens drawer. Takes out socks and underwear. Closes drawer. Puts on underwear. Puts on socks. Puts on pants. Puts on shirt. Buttons shirt. Opens closet. Takes out shoes. Puts on shoes. Ties shoelaces. Walks to desk. Picks up phone. Checks phone. Picks up bag. Puts phone in bag. Picks up keys. Puts keys in pocket. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Listens to music. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Gets off bus. Walks to office building. Enters building. Walks to elevator. Presses button. Waits for elevator. Enters elevator. Presses floor button. Elevator stops. Exits elevator. Walks to office door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office as community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at office. Greets colleagues. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Checks emails. Makes phone calls. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Writes report. Meets with volunteer. Eats lunch. Returns to desk. Updates database. Attends afternoon meeting. Prepares for next day. Shuts down computer. Leaves office.

Leaves office. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Gets off bus. Walks home. Enters house.

Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Closes refrigerator. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Adds spices. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Picks up plate. Walks to sink. Rinses plate. Places plate in dishwasher. Wipes table.

Enters living room. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Sits on sofa. Changes channel. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Changes channel. Watches TV. Pauses. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out drink. Closes refrigerator. Walks back to living room. Sits on sofa. Drinks. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Puts down remote.

Enters bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Waits for computer to start. Opens project file. Types on keyboard. Moves mouse. Clicks. Scrolls. Types more. Saves file. Opens browser. Searches for information. Reads. Closes browser. Saves file again. Turns off computer. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up.

Enters living room. Picks up book from coffee table. Sits on sofa. Opens book. Reads page. Turns page. Reads next page. Turns page. Continues reading. Closes book. Puts book down. Stands up. Stretches arms. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out water bottle. Closes refrigerator. Walks back to living room. Sits on sofa. Opens book again. Reads. Turns page. Reads. Closes book. Puts book down. Turns off lamp.

Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Washes hands with soap. Turns off tap. Dries hands with towel. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Enters bedroom. Opens drawer. Takes out pajamas. Closes drawer. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Picks up phone. Sets alarm. Puts phone on nightstand. Turns off desk lamp. Pulls back blanket. Lies down in bed. Pulls blanket over body.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Pulls blanket. Falls asleep.
